What does the buying process look like?
Threedy follows a structured, enterprise-friendly buying process. Typically, this starts with a discovery call to understand your ideas, use cases, data landscape, and stakeholders.

On this basis, we offer you a live demo, followed by a 1-month trial of Threedy's instant3Dhub at no cost to you. Depending on your requirements, we can support your internal evaluation workshops or carry out a 4- to 6-week standard proof-of-concept (PoC) project tailored to your needs.

Once scope and requirements are aligned, we move into commercial discussions and contract setup. Many customers start with a focused use case and expand gradually across teams and departments. Since the pricing model is usage-based, you only pay when the system is actively in use.

Threedy instant3Dhub is designed to integrate into existing IT landscapes. It connects non-invasively via APIs and standard interfaces to systems such as PLM, PDM, CAD repositories, ERP, and other enterprise data sources. Your systems remain untouched.
The instant3Dhub product was developed in collaboration with leading industrial manufacturers and refined over 15 years to meet the strict IT security requirements of German OEMs and their suppliers.
Threedy instant3Dhub supports enterprise-grade security concepts, including:
No uncontrolled file downloads by default

Threedy develops cloud-native products with universal deployment options. When choosing an implementation model, customers generally choose between on-premises or private cloud environments. Whichever model you prefer, Threedy operations experts will work closely with your IT and security teams to align with your internal security policies and respective industry standards.
Apart from a server infrastructure for instant3Dhub (see product section for specifications), no special hardware is required on the client side.

For this reason, we attach great importance to professional project management with jointly agreed, realistic milestones and a partnership-based approach involving all parties. Our Professional Services Team and Subject Matter Experts are always available to respond to or take on your specific needs and look forward to working with you.
How does Threedy help reduce data protection risks when collaborating on CAD data?

To enable this, instant3Dhub caches CAD data for Spatial Streaming onto any device. This typically reduces “data sprawl” and helps teams maintain a single source of truth, because access and updates remain tied to the original repository rather than to uncontrolled duplicates.

Data protection requirements still depend on your setup, data classification, and chosen integrations. instant3Dhub supports enterprise governance needs such as access control and auditable collaboration workflows, and we’re happy to clarify the specific data flows, storage/caching behavior, and deployment options during discovery to match your compliance expectations.

instant3Dhub gives AI agents structured access to your 3D and CAD data through its MCP server and APIs. Agents can query geometry, metadata, and assembly structure, and answers link back to the source model. It works with any model provider, whether OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or your own internal models, with no custom integration required.

We Hire for How You Think

Skills can be taught. The way you break down a problem you've never seen before can't. Our work starts where engineering data gets impossibly large and the obvious approach stops working. So we look for people who ask why something is done a certain way before asking how to do it faster.

We say what we think, in the room, while there's still time to act on it. That means flagging a problem in a release before a customer finds it, telling a colleague their idea has a hole in it, and admitting when something we shipped didn't work.
We move fast, but craft is never optional. We review each other's work properly, help when someone's stuck, take the unglamorous tasks that unblock everyone, and celebrate the wins together.
The principles that guide how we work, build, and grow together.
